The Royal Navy is preparing to deploy dozens of unmanned boats in UK waters to intercept Russian spy ships by the end of 2026. 
The new £12.3 million autonomous squadron will operate Kraken 3 vessels capable of reaching 55 knots and carrying up to 400kg of weapons or radar equipment. 
The move follows a reported 25% increase in Russian naval activity near British waters during the first seven months of 2026. 
Source: BBC
